verdict.rationale: Decagon is an AI customer-support agent platform, so a supervised draft-for-approval launch mode is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence documents one. The related features don't qualify: Suggestions drafts help-center content rather than customer replies, Simulations tests the agent before deployment rather than gating live replies, and Watchtower reviews interactions after they happen.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I can launch in a supervised mode where the agent drafts replies for human approval before anything reaches a customer
